Chapter 7088: Just Tell Him Already

Chapter 7088: Just Tell Him Already

Heaven’s Demise, Heaven’s Slayer, Dragongrasp, and the others appeared again with the grand momentum’s exposure.

Their life force became increasingly weak, replaced by death energy. In reality, they have died long ago and were just infused with someone else’s life force. This relied on the ocean of tribulation as the medium.

“What’s going on?!” Some immortals in the ocean felt the energy of death surrounding them.

They have grown used to this strange state since their death. Although this wasn’t living, it was still better than the alternative.

Unlike Heavenly Whale, they couldn’t face death with an open mind.

Spectators recalled how they were fearless at a young age. After all, they needed to be brave to become an immortal. Alas, this changed as they lived longer.

“Living longer seems to be more negative, it’s better to be young.” One immortal remarked.

“Fearless and free.” A primordial immortal said.

Despite not having power, authority, and treasures, they had a smile and a goal. During their struggle, they never relented once.

Perhaps becoming an immortal had changed them for the worse. Have they lived long enough? After all, they have possessed everything and experienced magnificent lives. Why would they need to be this wretched, clinging onto life?

“Maybe it’s time for some change, living a borrowed life is meaningless.” A golden immortal wondered.

Some clenched their fists, hoping they would be so pathetic and disgraceful before death. They wanted to be braver and die with a shred of dignity and composure.

“We’re dying.” Zhao Dachui said.

“You all are already dead, the life force from Heavenly Whale is dispersing.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Great Immortal, I yearn for life and wish to live!” Zhao Dachui waved his hand.

“So what?” Li Qiye said.

“You can take my memories or anything else as long as I can live.” He shouted.

“Unfortunately, your memories have nothing I want, you were merely a bedbug that had fallen into darkness.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Great Immortal, just let us know what you need.” He had an ugly expression but didn’t care at this moment.

Li Qiye ignored him and told Dragongrasp: “I don’t call for the memories of those who have fallen into darkness, just you.”

“I have nothing you need.” Dragongrasp uttered coldly.

“Who birthed you and where, for example.” Li Qiye said.

“Just tell him already.” Zhao Dachui urged.

Dragongrasp gave him a disdainful stare before answering: “I do not know.”

“That’s fine since I can trace the source and with that, you can return to the cycle and live again.” Li Qiye said.

“You can do that?!” An immortal in the ocean shouted.

“You will get no help from me.” Dragongrasp refused instantly to everyone’s astonishment.

“There’s someone you wish to protect even if it means losing the chance for rebirth.” Li Qiye said.

“Say what you want, I don’t have what you need anyway.” Dragongrasp said.

“You should know your effort is wasted, I will find it in the end. All this does is throw away your chance.” Li Qiye said.

Dragongrasp took a deep breath and said: “Since I’m already dead, I accept it.”

“Is it his mother that he wants to protect?” Many spectators speculated.
